value.rationale: An explicit sharp condition ratio on a naturally constrained tour incidence ensemble quantifies frame stability beyond classical rank/facet constraints. Equality of two symmetry sectors is structural, not a mere graph or parameter relabeling.

final_claim: For n>=6, the centered first Walsh covariance on uniform undirected Hamiltonian cycles avoiding one fixed edge has n zeros, eigenvalues 8(n-4)/(n-3)^2 with multiplicity 2(n-3), and 8(n-4)/((n-2)(n-3)) with multiplicity (n-2)(n-5)/2, giving ratio (n-2)/(n-3).
limitations: Only uniform measure, single forbidden edge, first-degree Walsh; not higher-order or arbitrary weighted tours.
